The Singing Ringing Tree Pick a breezy day to visit this modern sculpture to hear the haunting sounds made by the wind funnelling through the array of pipework.

Singing Ringing Tree This is one of a number of artworks being installed in Lancashire for a project entitled 'Panopticons' (historically, circular prisons!). As the name suggests the wind blowing over the open pipes can make it 'sing', although bashing it to make it for the 'ring' may well be frowned upon. In the distance on the right you can see the Coal Clough wind farm 155316
